फ: फ The twenty-second consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, the aspirate of the preceding letter, and expressed by Ph.

फ m. (फः) 1 Increasing, swelling, enlarging, expanding. 2 Performance of a mystical rite, by which KUVERA'S attendants are propitiated. 3 A high wind, a gale. 4 Wind expelled in yawning. 5 Fruitfulness, fertility. 6 An augmentor or increaser. nf. (फं फा) Unprofitable or idle speech. n. (फं) 1 Angry speech. 2 Bursting with some little noise, as air bubbles, boiling water, &c.; bubbling, boiling. f. (फा) Distress, anxiety. E. फल to bear fruit, or स्फाय to swell, aff. ड; in the latter case, the initial is rejected.
फक्क: फक्क r. 1st cl. (फक्कति) 1 To creep, to move slowly or sluggishly. 2 To behave ill, to practise ill or improper conduct.
फक्किका: फक्किका f. (-का) 1 A position, an assertion or argument, to be proved or maintained. 2 Logical exposition or elucidation. 3 A sophism. 4 A trick. 5 Illusion. 6 Fraud. E. फक्क to move slowly, aff. किकन्.
फञ्जिका: फञ्जिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 2 A species of Hedysarum, (H. alhagi.) E. भञ्ज to break, (disease,) aff. ण्वुल्, and the radical initial changed to फ.
फञ्जिपुत्रिका: फञ्जिपुत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. फञ्जि as above, and पुत्रिका infant.
फट: फट mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello. mf. (-टः-टा) 1 A tooth. 2 A cheat. E. स्फुट to burst or expand, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्, deriv. irr.
फट्: फट् ind. Exclamation of no meaning, forming part of a Mantra or incantation. E. स्फुट to burst, aff. क्विप् and the deriv. irr.
फण: फण r. 1st cl. (फणति) 1 To go. 2 To produce easily or readily 3 To be unoily. Causal form, (फाणयति) 1 To dilute. 2 To shine. (फणयति) To cause to go.
फण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello, &c. E. फण to go, aff. अच्.
फणकर: फणकर m. (-रः) A snake, especially the Cobra de capello, or COLUBER naja. E. फण the hood, and कर who makes; also फणाकर.
फणधर: फणधर m. (-रः) A snake. E. फण the hood, and धर who has; also फणाधर.
फणभृत्: फणभृत् m. (-भृत्) A snake. E. फण a hood, and भृत् who possesses.
फणमणि: फणमणि m. (-णिः) A jewel supposed to be in the head of a snake. E. फण, and मणि a gem.
फणवत्: फणवत् m. (-वान्) A snake. E. फणा a hood, and मतुप् possessive aff.
फणाकर: फणाकर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणकर.
फणाधर: फणाधर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणधर.
फणाभर: फणाभर m. (-रः) A snake. E. फण the hood expanded, भृ to possess, aff. अप्.
फणावत्: फणावत् m. (-वान्) A snake: see फणवत्.
फणिकेशर: फणिकेशर m. (-रः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. फणिन् a snake, and केशर filaments.
फणिखेल: फणिखेल m. (-लः) A quail. E. फणि a snake, and खेल who plays.
फणिज्झक: फणिज्झक m. (-कः) A plant, also Marüa. f. (-का) A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī, apparently a sort of basil with small leaves. E. फणि for फणी a snake, and उज्झ to abandon, aff. वुन्, deriv. irr.
फणित: फणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Diluted. E. फण to go, क्त aff.
फणितल्पग: फणितल्पग m. (-गः) VIṢṆU. E. फणि a snake, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.
फणिन्: फणिन् m. (-णी) A snake. E. फण a hood, and इनि aff.
फणिप्रिय: फणिप्रिय m. (-यः) Air, wind. E. फणि for फणी a snake, and प्रिय fond of.
फणीश्वर: फणीश्वर m. (-रः) The great serpent ANANTA. E. फणि a snake, and ईश्वर sovereign; also फणीन्द्र, &c.
फण्ड: फण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The belly. E. फण to go, Uṇādi aff. ड.
फत्कारिन्: फत्कारिन् m. (-री) A bird. E. फत् imitative sound, and कारिन who makes.
फर: फर n. (-रं) A shield. E. र substituted for ल; see फल.
फर्फरीक: फर्फरीक m. (-कं) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. n. (-कं) Sweetness. E. स्फुर to expand, Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the form irr.
फल: फल r. 1st cl. (फलति) 1 To produce or bear fruit. 2 To make fruitful, to fructify. 3 To go. (ञि, आ;) ञिफला r. 1st cl. (फलति) To divide, to cleave or split.

फल n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of any plant, fruit in general. 2 Fruit (metaphorically), result, produce, consequence. 3 Prosperity, flourishing, thriving. 4 Gain, profit, acquisition. 5 Recompense, reward. 6 A shield. 7 The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an arrow, &c. 8 A sort of fragrant berry and drug, commonly Kakoli. 9 A nutmeg. 10 The three myrobalans collectively. 11 The menstrual discharge. 12 Gift, giving. 13 A ploughshare. 14 The quotient of a sum, (in arithmetic.) 15 The area of a circle, &c. 16 An equation. 17 (In astronomy,)  The anomalistic equation of a planet. f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. m. (-लः) A plant, (Echites antidysenterica, Rox.:) see कुटज. E. फल to bear or produce fruit, aff. अच्.
फलक: फलक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A shield. 2 A bench. 3 A plank. 4 A layer. m. (-कः) 1 A bone, the os frontis, or bone of the forehead. 2 A leaf or page for writing on. 3 A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) n. (-कं) The buttocks. E. कन् added to the preceding, or फल to split or divide, aff. वुन्.
फलकपाणि: फलकपाणि m. (-णिः) A soldier armed with a shield. E. फलक, and पाणि the hand.
फलकामना: फलकामना f. (-ना) Desire of any consequence. E. फल, and कामना desiring.
फलकिन्: फलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Having, or being armed with a shield, &c. m. (-की) A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi. E. फलक as above, and इनि aff.
फलकेशर: फलकेशर m. (-रः) The cocoanut tree. E. फल the fruit, and केशर hair, covered with a fibrous coat like hair.
फलकोषक: फलकोषक m. (-कः) The scrotum or testicles. E. फल fruit, कोष sheath, and कन् aff. of comparison.
फलकृष्ण: फलकृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) A small fruit, (Carissa carandas.) E. फल fruit, and कृष्ण black.
फलग्रहि: फलग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्, also फलेग्रहि.
फलग्राहिन्: फलग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A tree. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. णिनि.
फलखण्डन: फलखण्डन n. (-नं) Disappointing. E. फल, and खण्डन destroying.
फलचमस: फलचमस n. (-सं) The bark of the Indian fig, ground and eaten with curds, by way of penance.
फलत्: फलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Yielding fruit, profit, &c. E. फल to bear fruit, शतृ aff.
फलत्रय: फलत्रय n. (-यं) 1 Three sorts of fruit collectively, as the fruit of the vine, the Parush, and the Gmelina arborea. 2 The three myrobalans. E. फल fruit, and त्रय three.
फलत्रिक: फलत्रिक n. (-कं) The three myrobalans collectively. E. फल fruit, and त्रिक three-fold.
फलद: फलद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding or bearing fruit, results, &c. m. (-दः) A tree. E. फल fruit, and द what gives; also फलदातृ, फलदायिन्, &c.
फलन: फलन n. (-नं) Fructifying, bearing fruit, producing consequences. E. फल, and ल्युट् aff.
फलनिवृत्ति: फलनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Cessation of consequences. E. फल, and निवृत्ति stop.
फलनिर्वृत्ति: फलनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Final consequence or result. E. फल, and निर्वृत्ति completion.
फलनिष्पत्ति: फलनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Bearing fruit. 2 Yielding profit or desired results. E. फल, and निष्पत्ति putting forth.
फलपाक: फलपाक m. (-कः) 1 The ripening of fruit. 2 The fulness of consequences. 3 The Caronda. E. फल fruit, and पाक ripening.
फलपाकान्ता: फलपाकान्ता f. (-न्ता) An annual plant. E. फल fruit, पाक ripening or ripeness, and अन्त end; dying after bearing fruit.
फलपातन: फलपातन n. (-नं) Knocking down or gathering fruit. E. फल, and पातन felling.
फलपुच्छ: फलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A sort of esculent root or bulb. E. फल fruit, and पुच्छ a tail.
फलपूर: फलपूर m. (-रः) Common citron, (Citrus medica.) E. फल fruit, and पूर to fill, aff. क.
फलपूरक: फलपूरक m. (-कः) Common citron. E. कन् added to the last.
फलप्रद: फलप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding fruit, productive, yielding a reward, &c. E. फल, and प्रद what gives.
फलप्रयुक्त: फलप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit, &c. E. फल, and प्रयुक्त applied.
फलप्राप्ति: फलप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining the desired result or fruit. E. फल, and प्राप्ति acquiring.
फलभाज्: फलभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Having or receiving fruit, consequence, &c. E. फल, and भाज् who shares.
फलभूमि: फलभूमि f. (-मिः) Any region not included in the known continent, as heaven, hell, &c. E. फल fruit, (of actions,) and भूमि earth.
फलभोग: फलभोग m. (गः) 1 Receipt or enjoyment of consequences. 2 Possession of rent or profit, usufruct. E. फल, and भोग enjoyment.
फलभोगिन्: फलभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who receives the profits, consequences, &c. E. फल, and भोगिन् who enjoys.
फलमुद्गरिका: फलमुद्गरिका f. (-का) A sort of date. E. फल fruit, and मुद्गर a mal- let, aff. कन् in the fem. form.
फलवत्: फलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Bearing fruit. 2 Yielding results, or consequences. E. फल fruit, and मतुप् poss. aff.
फलशाडव: फलशाडव m. (-वः) The pomegranate. E. फल fruit, शाड to extol, aff. अव.
फलशालिन्: फलशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Bearing or yielding fruit. E. फल, and शालिन् having.
फलश्रेष्ठ: फलश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The mango. E. फल fruit, and श्रेष्ठ best.
फलस: फलस m. (-सः) The jack or bread fruit. E. फल fruit, सह to be able, aff. डः see पनस.
फलसम्पद्: फलसम्पद् f. (-पद् or पत्) Prosperity, success. E. फल, and सम्पत् abundance.
फलसम्भव: फलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or by fruit. E. फल, and सम्भव born; also फलसम्भू.
फलसाधन: फलसाधन n. (-नं) Means or instrument of success. E. फल, and साघन means.
फलसिद्धि: फलसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Realising an object, reaping the fruit of any act. E. फल, and सिद्धि perfection.
फलहानि: फलहानि f. (-निः) Loss of fruit or profit. E. फल, and हानि abandonment.
फलानुसरण: फलानुसरण n. (-णं) Rate or aggregate of profits. E. फल, and अनुसरण conformity.
फलाकाङ्क्षा: फलाकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Hope or expectation of favourable consequences. E. फल, and आकाङ्क्षा desire.
फलादन: फलादन m. (-नः) A parrot. E. फल fruit, अदन eating.
फलाध्यक्ष: फलाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, commonly Khirani, (Mimusops Kauki.) E. फल fruit, अध्यक्ष superintendant.
फलान्त: फलान्त m. (-न्तः) A bambu. E. फल fruit or blossom, अन्त end.
फलापेक्षा: फलापेक्षा f. (-क्षा) Regard to or expectation of consequences. E. फल, and अपेक्षा expectation.
फलापेत: फलापेत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Unproductive, unfertile. E. फल, and अपेत deprived.
फलाशन: फलाशन m. (-नः) A parrot. E. फल fruit, and अशन food.
फलाशिन्: फलाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Living on fruits. E. फल, and अशिन् who eats.
फलासक्त: फलासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Doing any thing for the sake of reward. 2 Fond of or seeking to pluck fruit. E. फल, and आसक्त attached to.
फलित: फलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fruitful, bearing fruit. 2 Successful, yielding a result. m. (-तः) A tree. E. फल fruit, and इतच् aff.
फलिन्: फलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Bearing fruit, fruitful. 2 Productive of consequences. m. (-ली) 1 A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi (Mystus kapirat.) 2 A tree, especially in fruit. f. (-नी) 1 A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. 2 A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) 3 A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. फल fruit, and इनि aff.
फलाभोग: फलाभोग m. (गः) Non-enjoyment of profits, &c. E. फल, and अभोग non-use.
फलूष: फलूष m. (-षः) A sort of creeper. E. फल fruit, and ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
फलेग्रहि: फलेग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Bearing fruit in season, fruitful. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्; ए substituted irregularly for the final of फल; also फलग्रहि and फलेग्राहिन्.
फलेग्राहिन्: फलेग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Bearing fruit in due season. E. as above, णिनि aff.
फलेरुहा: फलेरुहा f. (-हा) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. फल fruit, in the seventh case, रुह to grow, aff. क.
फलोच्चय: फलोच्चय m. (-यः) 1 Collecting of fruits. 2 A collection of fruits. E. फल, and उच्चय abundance.
फलोत्तमा: फलोत्तमा f. (-मा) 1 A small sort of rope. 2 The benefit arising from sacred study. E. फल fruit, उत्तभ best.
फलोपेत: फलोपेत mfn. (त-ता-तं) Having or yielding fruit, &c. E. फल, and उपेत possessing.
फलोत्पति: फलोत्पति m. (-तिः) The mango. E. फल fruit, उत् over, पति ruler.
फलोदय: फलोदय m. (-यः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Heaven, paradise. 3 Joy, happiness. 4 Consequence, result. E. फल fruit, gain, &c. उदय rising.
फलोद्देश: फलोद्देश m. (-शः) Regard to results. E. फल, and उद्देश pointing out.
फल्क: फल्क m. (-ल्कः) An expanded or extended body. E. फल to separate, Uṇādi aff. क.
फल्गु: फल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) 1 Pithless, sapless. 2 Vain, unprofitable, unmeaning, useless. 3 Weak, feeble. f. (-ल्गुः) 1 The oppositeleaved fig tree, (F. oppositi-folia, Rox.) 2 The name of a river which is said to run underneath Gaya. 3 Falsehood, false or lying speech. 4 A red powder, usually of the root of wild ginger, coloured with sappan wood, and thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the Holi festival. 5 The spring season. E. फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. गुक्
फल्गुन: फल्गुन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ARJUNA. 2 The month Phālguna. f. (-नी) The constellation Phalgunī. E. फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. उनन् and गुक् aug.: see फाल्गुन.
फल्गुनाल: फल्गुनाल m. (-लः) The month Phālguna. E. फल्गु, and अल equal to, the same.
फल्य: फल्य n. (-ल्यं) A bud, a flower. E. फल fruit, यत् aff.
फल्लकिन्: फल्लकिन् m. (-की) A fish, caught in ponds, commonly Phalāi, (Mystus kapirat.)
फाट्: फाट् ind. An interjection of calling.
फाणि: फाणि f. (-णिः) 1 Unrefined sugar, molasses. 2 Flour or meal mixed with curds. E. स्फायी to swell, Uṇādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
फाणित: फाणित n. (-तं) Raw sugar, the inspissated juice of the sugar cane. E. फण to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
फाण्ट: फाण्ट mfn. (-ण्टः-ण्टा-ण्टं) Readily prepared, made by an extemporaneous easy process, (decoction, &c.). n. (-ण्टं) 1 Diluted decoction, decoction easily prepared. 2 The first particles of butter that are produced by churning. E. फण to prepare easily, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
फाल: फाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of cotton, (vesture.) m. (-लः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of BALARĀMA. n. (-लं) The share of a plough. E. फल to divide, in the causal form, aff. अच्; or फल fruit, and अण् aff.
फालकृष्ट: फालकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Furrowed, ploughed. n. (-ष्टं) A ploughed field. E. फाल, and कृष्ट furrowed.
फाल्गुन: फाल्गुन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ARJUNA. 2 A sort of tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 3 A month, commonly called by the name Phālguna, (February-March.) f. (-नी) 1 Day of full moon on the month Phālguna, on which the Holī or great vernal festival of the Hindus is celebrated. 2 A name common to the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets first and last, or पूर्व्व and उन्तरः see पूर्व्वफाल्गुनी, &c.
फाल्गुनानुज: फाल्गुनानुज m. (-जः) Spring. E. फाल्गुन the month, अनु according, and ज born.
फाल्गुनिक: फाल्गुनिक m. (-कः) The month Phālguna. E. फाल्गुनी day of full moon in this month, and ठक् aff.
फि: फि m. (फिः) Anger, passion. E. फल to separate, aff. डि.
फिङ्गक: फिङ्गक m. (-कः) The fork-tailed shrike. E. फिङ्ग imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड.
फुट: फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) The hood or expanded neck of a snake. E. स्फुट to swell, aff. क, deriv. irr.
फुत्: फुत् ind. 1 Expression of disregard or contempt, (Phoo, hoot.) 2 Imitative sound, implying the bubbling or boiling of water &c. or of blowing into any liquid. E. स्फुर to swell, aff. क्विप्, स rejected, and तुक् added, form irr.
फुत्कर: फुत्कर m. (-रः) Fire. E. फुत् boiling, and कर who makes.
फुत्कार: फुत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Arrogant, contemptuous, disdainful. m. (-रः) 1 The sound of bubbling, &c. 2 Blowing or breathing into, (as to cool it.) E. फुत् expression of contempt, and कार who makes.
फुत्कृत: फुत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown up, (as a bubble.) 2 Blown into, cooled by blowing into it. E. फुत्, and कृत made.
फुप्फुस: फुप्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs: see पुप्फुस.
फुल्ल: फुल्ल r. 1st. cl. (फुल्लति) To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.
फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, opened, expanded as a flower. 2 Opened (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay. E. फुल्ल to blow, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
फुल्लदामन्: फुल्लदामन् n. (-म) A species of the Atidhṛti metre.
फुल्लनयन: फुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Full or large-eyed. 2 Smiling, looking happy. E. फुल्ल, and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र, फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.
फुल्लफाल: फुल्लफाल m. (-लः) Winnowing corn. E. फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.
फुल्ललोचन: फुल्ललोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Full-eyed. 2 Looking pleased or happy. n. (-नं) A large full eye. m. (-नः) A species of the antelope. E. फुल्ल full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.
फुल्लवत्: फुल्लवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Blossoming, blowing. E. फुल्ल to blow, क्तवतु aff.
फुल्लवदन: फुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking pleased or happy. E. फुल्ल, and वदन the face.
फुल्लि: फुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Blowing, blossoming. E. फुल्ल to blow, aff. इन्.
फुल्लिति: फुल्लिति f. (तिः) Flowering, blossoming. E. फुल्ल to blow, क्तिन् aff.
फूत्: फूत् ind. Imitative sound of bubbling, sobbing, &c.: see फुत्.
फूत्कार: फूत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Bubbling. 2 Sobbing. 3 Blowing or breathing into any liquid. E. फूत्, and कार making.
फूत्कृत: फूत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bubbled, bubbling, made to sound so. 2 Blown or breathed into, (a liquid.) 3 Sounded as in sobbing. E. फूत्, and कृत made.
फेन: फेन m. (-नः) 1 Froth, foam. 2 Cuttle fish bone, supposed to be the indurated foam of the sea. 3 Vapour. E. स्फायी to swell, नक् Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
फेनक: फेनक m. (-कः) Cuttle fish bone. f. (-का) 1 Rice, ground and boiled with water. 2 The soap berry. E. फेन froth, and कन् aff.
फेनता: फेनता f. (-ता) Frothiness, vapour. E. तल् added to फेन; also with त्व, फेनत्वं.
फेनल: फेनल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. E. फेन froth, अलच् poss. aff.; also with इलच् similar aff. फेनिल, and with the usual possessive मतुप्, फेनवत्.
फेनवत्: फेनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Frothy, foaming, bubbling. E. फेन froth, and मतुप् aff.
फेनवाहिन्: फेनवाहिन् m. (-ही) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. फेन foam, वह to bear, aff. णिनि; INDRA having used the foam of the sea for his thunderbolt, to kill the demon VṚTRĀSURA.
फेनाग्र: फेनाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A bubble. E. फेन foam, and अग्र top.
फेनायमान: फेनायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Foaming, frothing. E. फेन nom. verb to foam, शानच् aff.
फेनाशनि: फेनाशनि m. (-निः) A name of INDRA. E. फेन foam, and अशनि the thunderbolt: see फेनवाहिन्.
फेनिका: फेनिका f. (-का) Froth arising from treacle. E. फेन foam, कन् added, fem. form.
फेनिल: फेनिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. m. (-लः) The soap plant, (Sapindus detergens, Rox.) n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 The fruit of the Vangueria spinosa. E. फेन froth or foam, इलच् aff.
फेरण्ड: फेरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A jackal. E. फे imitative sound, रम to sport, aff. ड.
फेरव: फेरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 2 Malicious, noxious, injurious. m. (-वः) 1 A jackal or shacal. 2 A demon, a goblin. E. फे imitative sound, रु to utter, aff. अप्.
फेरु: फेरु m. (-रुः) A jackal. E. फे imitative sound, रु to cry, aff. डु.
फेल: फेल (ऋ) फेलृ r. 10th cl. (फेलति) To go or move.
फेलक: फेलक m. (-कः) Orts, leavings of a meal, or droppings from the mouth. E. फेल to go, वुन् aff.
फेला: फेला f. (-ला) Orts, leavings. E. फेल to go, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्; also फेलक and फेलि.
फेलि: फेलि f. (-लिः or ली) Orts, leavings. E. फेल to go, इन् aff., ङीप् optionally added; also with टाप् and कन् added, फेलिका f. (-का)
फ्वल: फ्वल r. 1st cl. (फ्वलति) To live. ब
